title: Yuu Sprint Trail
description: Sprint-generated energy system with burst activation.
body:
# Yuu Sprint Trail

Sprint-generated energy system with burst activation.

## Features
- Running and sprinting builds up trail energy over distance.
- Particle trail feedback while charging movement energy.
- Spend energy on Trail Burst for strong speed/jump window.
- Built-in cooldown and granular tuning in config.

## Command
- `/sprinttrail [status|burst|on|off|reload]`

## Permission
- `yuusprinttrail.use`

## Compatibility
- Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
- Game versions: 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.1

## Notes
- Lightweight implementation with configurable behavior in `config.yml`.
- Built by **yuutaxd**.
